title: AdS$_9$ solutions in type II supergravities
summary: We present new solutions in type II supergravities describing AdS$_9$ geometries warped over an interval. In type IIB, we construct an analytic family of backgrounds supported by a non-trivial axio-dilaton profile. Despite the presence of strong-coupling singularities at both ends of the interval, these solutions exhibit both a finite Euclidean on-shell action and a finite holographic central charge.
